findings.mutations: no_device_mutation=true; no profile was captured and no write operation ran; BrowserWindow stayed hidden and cleanup completed.
findings.chooser: Chooser enumerated COM1 and FluxRail COM29. COM29 had portName=COM29, vendorId=9114, productId=51966 and deviceInstanceId USB\\VID_239A&PID_CAFE&MI_00\\7&1E2FBD10&0&0000, but Electron SerialPort metadata lacked serialNumber.
findings.device: cdc.json is empty; there was no hello, handshake, or firmware request.
findings.firmware: No evidence of firmware/device failure; target CDC appeared in chooser metadata but selection stopped in host-side binding.
findings.originPermission: Permission check for http://localhost:4174/ was allowed; permission request/device callbacks did not follow.
findings.selection: The strict serialNumber+COM29 predicate therefore selected zero ports and callback received empty string. requestPort then raised NotFoundError: No port selected by the user.

limitations: Not a Web Serial pass; no SerialPort opened.
This identifies a host metadata mismatch in the chooser mapping, not a board defect.
A later preselection mapping must resolve COM29 deviceInstanceId to the target USB parent serial uniquely before returning a portId; never fall back to selecting an arbitrary COM port.
recommendation: Proceed only after the v3 host-side COM-to-PnP-parent-serial resolver passes a read-only metadata preflight and guarantees exactly one match before chooser callback selection.
